review: DEEPSEEK-009 reviewed real Claude moderation: require trusted policy threshold, bound timestamps, expiry/revocation and exact project/purpose. Exact opaque URI equality is acceptable. Registry authenticity and trusted clock are external preconditions; pure hashing cannot prove them or source truth. Within-window replay prevention is not claimed. Claude corrected its mistaken attribution of the Qwen 4/day budget to DeepSeek. Analysis is unverified, not executed model code.
